filer_name.rationale: PersonFilingThisReturn/PersonNm is the closest match for the individual filer's name; if the filer is a business, idx 42 (BusinessNameLine1Txt under PersonFilingThisReturn) would apply, but PersonNm is the primary leaf for a named filer.

filer_identifying_number.rationale: No single canonical element under PersonFilingThisReturn captures SSN/ITIN/EIN as a unified 'identifying number'; the schema splits these into separate SSN/EIN/ITIN elements not present in the candidate list — blueprint should split into SSN, EIN, or ITIN fields.

filer_address.rationale: PersonFilingThisReturn/USAddress/AddressLine1Txt matches the street address of the filer for a U.S. address; blueprint bundles full address into one string while canonical schema splits it — blueprint should split into AddressLine1Txt, AddressLine2Txt, CityNm, StateAbbreviationCd, ZIPCd.

filer_city.rationale: PersonFilingThisReturn/USAddress/CityNm directly maps to the filer's city for a domestic mailing address.

filer_state.rationale: PersonFilingThisReturn/USAddress/StateAbbreviationCd directly maps to the two-letter state abbreviation of the filer's address.

filer_zip.rationale: PersonFilingThisReturn/USAddress/ZIPCd directly maps to the ZIP code of the filer's mailing address.

filer_country.rationale: PersonFilingThisReturn/ForeignAddress/CountryCd maps to the ISO country code for a filer with a foreign mailing address.

tax_year_begin.rationale: TaxYearBeginDt corresponds to the 'Annual accounting period beginning' date shown at the top of page 1.

tax_year_end.rationale: TaxYearEndDt corresponds to the 'Annual accounting period ending' date shown at the top of page 1.

is_amended_return.rationale: No candidate element for an amended-return checkbox is present in the closed candidate list for IRS5471.

filer_category.rationale: The blueprint bundles the category into one field, but the canonical schema splits it into separate boolean indicators (CategoryOfFiler1aInd through CategoryOfFiler5cInd, idx 9–17); blueprint should be refactored into individual boolean fields per category.

corporation_name.rationale: ForeignCorporation/BusinessName/BusinessNameLine1Txt maps directly to the foreign corporation's name in item 1a.

corporation_ein.rationale: EmployerEIN with row label referencing item 1b(1) matches the foreign corporation's U.S. EIN.

corporation_reference_id.rationale: ForeignEntityIdentificationGrp/ForeignEntityReferenceIdNum maps to item 1b(2) reference ID number.

corporation_country_of_incorporation.rationale: CountryUnderWhoseLawsIncCd matches item 1c 'Country under whose laws incorporated'.

corporation_address.rationale: ForeignCorporation/ForeignAddress is the closest grouping for the corporation's principal office address; blueprint bundles the full address into one string while canonical splits into sub-elements — blueprint should split into AddressLine1Txt, CityNm, CountryCd, etc.

principal_business_activity_code.rationale: PrincipalBusinessActivityCd maps to the six-digit business activity code in item 1f.

principal_business_activity.rationale: PrincipalBusinessActivityDesc maps to the plain-language description of the principal business activity in item 1g.

schedule_a_stock.rationale: Schedule A stock class detail is not represented by any leaf element in the closed candidate list; it would require a separate schedule-level group not present here.

schedule_b_us_shareholders.rationale: Schedule B Part I detail rows are not represented as leaf elements in the closed candidate list; PersonInformationIsFiledFor (idx 56) is a group element, not a leaf, and does not cover the full array structure.

schedule_b_constructive_owners.rationale: Schedule B Part II constructive owner rows are not represented as distinct leaf elements in the closed candidate list.

schedule_e_taxes.rationale: Schedule E foreign income tax rows are not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

schedule_j_ep.rationale: Schedule J E&P rows are not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

schedule_m_transactions.rationale: Schedule M transaction rows are not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

schedule_o_acquisitions.rationale: Schedule O Part I acquisition rows are not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

schedule_o_dispositions.rationale: Schedule O Part II disposition rows are not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

schedule_o_reorganizations.rationale: Schedule O Part III reorganization rows are not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

schedule_q_income_groups.rationale: Schedule Q income group rows are not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.
